messages:
Alex H: Quick sync — Catalyst Health on-prem handoff. Target deploy Wed Apr 20. Main open items: firewall rule merge, air-gap image signing, canary window, and CR approvals. tagging owners.
Priya N: I can own firewall merge. Need final egress list from SEs and a signed IP list from customer. :thumbsup:
Jordan R: sending IP list now (customer confirmed 10.12.0.0/16 + three public CIDRs). Also need to confirm jumpbox access method.
Jordan R: quick note — Catalyst wants no outbound to non-whitelisted hosts during install. We'll use our shrinkwrap images.
Sam T: For jumpbox we recommend bastion with port 22 + proxy command. I'll draft SSH bastion instructions and a TF module to create SGs.
Sam T: also, are we doing image signing or checksum-only? I thought legal wanted signed artifact for air-gapped installs.
Mei L: Legal asked for signed artifacts + manifest. Ops needs verification steps. Can we add a post-install smoke test that validates signatures?
Alex H: Yes — plan: 1) images signed by CI, 2) manifest with sha256 for each file, 3) smoke test runs verify signatures + simple inference trace.
Priya N: Firewall ports: allow outbound 443 for license check, 9000 for artifact fetch via proxy, 12345 for heartbeat to monitoring (customer agreed). Also allow internal CIDRs for k8s control plane.
Priya N: snippet for ops to paste into firewall team:
```
# egress rules (example)
- ports: 443,9000,12345
- cidrs: 10.12.0.0/16, 52.14.23.0/24, 34.198.0.0/16
```
Jordan R: adding the snippet to the customer doc now. Also pinging Catalyst for when they can open the jumpbox SSH from our SRE IP pool.
Sam T: For canary — proposing 2-hour low-traffic window night of Wed, followed by 24h validation. Rollback plan: restore previous model bundle + DNS swap. Any objections?
Mei L: I want an explicit metric list for validation: p99 latency, successful inference rate, error spikes, and token billing sanity. If any breach -> auto rollback.
Alex H: Good call. Jordan, can you own the validation dashboard and alert thresholds?
Jordan R: Yep, will create dashboard and alerts. ETA EOD Tue.
deploy-bot: scheduled: catalyst-canary-slot Wed 2026-04-20 02:00-04:00 UTC (owner: Sam T).
Alex H: Action items summary: Priya -> merge firewall rules + send final patch; Sam -> TF module + canary ops runbook; Jordan -> dashboard + IP list confirmation; Mei -> smoke test + signature verifier; Alex -> coordinate customer cutover and CR approvals. Please add to the PRs and tag reviewers.
Priya N: merging rules now, will tag @Sam T for review.
Sam T: will draft runbook and post link here when ready.
Jordan R: dashboard stub up — https://internal.grafana/redwood/d/catalyst (will update thresholds).
Mei L: smoke test script starting point (will push to repo and link).
Alex H: Great — if we hit any blockers please flag in this thread. Otherwise we treat this as on-track. :eyes:
